description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Cod' which extends a base controller class in the OpenCart system. It manages the Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method, including rendering the payment form and confirming the order. The class has methods for displaying the payment page and processing the confirmation, such as updating order status and redirecting to the success page.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for handling the Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the COD payment method page; loads language, retrieves configuration, and renders the view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the order confirmation process for COD payments; updates order status and returns JSON response.
